Officer's narrative
Driver 1 reported a concussion following a rear-end collision in Pasadena, Texas. Driver 2 was stopped in traffic when
the front of Driver 1's vehicle struck the rear of Driver 2's car. The damage to both vehicles matches the reported
impact, and the injury Driver 1 describes is consistent with the force of a crash of this kind. Photographs taken at the
scene confirm some of the details, but no independent witnesses were located. Those who spoke with me at the
scene, along with my own observations, indicate that Driver 1 was not inside the vehicle when the collision occurred,
which conflicts with Driver 1's account. Records and the vehicle's owner reflect no earlier damage to the vehicle.
Driver 1 is named on the insurance policy covering the vehicle involved in the collision.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
